Spend 1 Leadership for the Host Resolve Check. Rolls: 10 and 7. Choose one.
Host Resolve: 7 against Morale 5. Lose 1 Leadership after the Priest modifier.

The gates are broken. Smoke hangs above the walls as the last organized defenders scatter through Middelalderen.
The Host enters Middelalderen in force, roughly 1,500 fighters still under its banners after losing 5 Units in the assault.
Exhaustion gives way to the first stunned realization that the long campaign is finally over.
Not every road to Middelalderen was made by force. The Host leaves friends behind it among Pale Hands, Nightstone.
Old grudges remain beyond the city walls. Sun-Touched will remember the Host differently.
Every hard march, bargain, refusal, risk, and compromise now lies behind the Host. Some consequences returned on the road. Others never had the chance.
